notes: Intro: Platform helps institutional asset managers search and rerank research, legal, compliance docs.
Primary pain: current elastic cluster struggles at scale — vector dims 1536, 120M vectors and rising. Index build times + cold-query latency spikes.
Customer objective: deliver semantic search + reranking for analyst workflows; goal p99 <200ms for single-query (embedding + rerank) under expected concurrency.
Current infra: mixed — pgvector for metadata-heavy joins, Elastic for keyword fallbacks, experiments with Pinecone for eval runs.
POC scope agreed: ingest 10M doc vectors (sample), integrate 3 candidate vector DBs (Weaviate, Pinecone, pgvector) via Redwood connectors, compare recall/latency/cost per query.
Reranking approach: lightweight ANN candidate retrieval (k=200) then cross-encoder rerank on Redwood-hosted model; want to test cost tradeoff (ann k vs cross-encoder qps).
Cost targets: heatmap goal cost per query < $0.002 for retrieval stage and total end-to-end <$0.007 considering rerank compute; highly cost-sensitive for metered product.
Indexing needs: bulk ingest API, streaming delta ingestion, per-namespace sharding, TTL for ephemeral data, and metadata filtering on fields (client_id, region, security_label).

Connector requirements: must support batched upserts, incremental deletes, guaranteed ordering for document versions, ability to store vector + sparse fields, and filter pushdown to reduce candidate set size before ANN step.
Preferences: prefer cosine similarity for semantics; some older models use dot-product — need runtime metric mapping and fallback to L2 if required by DB implementation.
Security ask: VPC peering + private endpoints for dedicated deployment; KMS integration for key rotation; audit log export to customer SIEM.
Decision factors: query latency SLOs, egress cost for hosted DB, connector maintenance burden, ability to run private in-customer VPC for EU data residency.
Quote from CTO: 'We can accept a slightly lower recall if it buys us consistent sub-200ms user-facing latency.'
SE notes: Will measure recall@10/100 with existing human-labeled eval set; propose automated rerank cost analysis in Redwood Optimize to recommend k and batching settings.
Procurement note: Legal raised questions around Pinecone's EU residency; they prefer Weaviate or self-hosted pgvector for certain regulated clients.
Timeline: security questionnaire sent 2026-02-15; POC kickoff 2026-02-22; mid-POC check 2026-03-05.
Internal ask: add sample ingestion scripts for pgvector chunking and a Weaviate schema template; provide cost comparison spreadsheet for 10M vectors across providers.
Potential upsell: Redwood Dedicated for predictable throughput + on-net VPC for EU accounts.
Conversation snippets: 'Need a connector that can do hybrid search (sparse + dense) with metadata filters in the query path' — Head of Search.
Follow-ups: security team to review SOC2 docs; infra to validate network topology for private deployment; SE to deliver rerank latency baseline by 2026-03-12.
